item.text:
Implemented `eligibleSubtotalCents` on every quote. Promotion minimums and discounts now use only eligible products, including quantities and repeated lines, with rounding applied once to the combined base.

Full subtotals, line order, caps, validation, and ownership behavior are preserved.

Validation: `npm run typecheck` passed; `npm test` passed all 7 tests. No blockers. npm emitted an existing configuration warning about `home`.
